summary.text: Julian Cyr, listed by Ballotpedia as Julian Andre Cyr, is a Democratic state senator from Massachusetts who has represented the Cape and Islands District since January 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Housing.

paragraphs.text: Cyr assumed office on January 4, 2017, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Joint Committee on Housing and is vice chair of the Joint Committee on Public Health.

He was also assigned to the Joint Committees on Health Care Financing, on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery, on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, and on Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy.
